features: Eagle Eye Cloud Managed Video Recorder (CMVR): stores video locally and acts as a gateway to the Eagle Eye cloud
Video encrypted in transit and at rest
Datasheet: Bridges and CMVRs support ONVIF Profile S IP cameras
Max cameras: up to 165 IP cameras @4MP (typical)
Storage capacity: 192 TB (raw), 160 TB (useable) RAID 6 per 2025 datasheet; 2023 datasheet states 120 TB (raw), 100TB (useable) RAID 6
Conflict: LPR support stated as No in the 2023 datasheet and Yes in the 2025 datasheet; value omitted
Conflict: video output stated as HDMI (1), VGA (1), DP (1) in the 2023 datasheet and HDMI (2), DP (2) in the 2025 datasheet; value omitted
Conflict: dimensions stated as 437 x 647 x 89 mm in the 2023 datasheet and 483 x 686 x 89 mm in the 2025 datasheet; value omitted
Conflict: maximum power consumption stated as 280 W in the 2023 datasheet and 800 W in the 2025 datasheet; value omitted
